judged_text: No enqueue-time dedupe and no negative caching on the retrieve path (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15, app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:8-10, lib/topic_retriever.rb:21-33): every embed impression enqueues a job, so a page whose topic can never be imported floods the Sidekiq queue with near-duplicate jobs whose only work is a failed setnx; the 60s throttle only applies inside job execution and is set before retrieval regardless of outcome, so permanently failing URLs (404, readability-empty, fetch error) are re-fetched up to once per minute indefinitely as long as they have viewers.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `topic_id` exists it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` on every request and renders `loading`. The loading view auto-reloads every 30s, further driving repeated requests. There is no enqueue-time dedupe, and the only throttle (`TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` using `$redis.setnx`/`expire`) happens inside job execution, so the Sidekiq queue can accumulate many near-duplicate jobs that mostly exit early due to the redis key. Also, `retrieved_recently?` sets the throttle key before any fetch outcome is known, so permanently failing URLs will continue to be retried (up to once per minute) indefinitely as long as impressions keep triggering enqueues.
